checkpoints.name: Finish: Kalakaua Ave at Kapiolani Park

description: A pre-dawn start at Ala Moana, a loop through downtown, Waikiki and Kapiolani Park, then up and around Diamond Head, out along Kalanianaole Highway to Hawaii Kai and back through Kahala, and over Diamond Head again to the finish in Kapiolani Park. Flat but for the two Diamond Head climbs. Unofficial.

source.notes: 2026 course: the start on Ala Moana Blvd, a loop through downtown (Punchbowl, Queen, Bishop, Merchant, Bethel and King Streets), Kapiolani Blvd, Kona St, Atkinson Dr, Kalakaua Ave through Waikiki, Monsarrat and Paki Avenues past Kapiolani Park, Diamond Head Rd around the crater, 18th Ave, Kilauea Ave, Kalanianaole Hwy east to the Hawaii Kai Dr and Keahole St loop and back, Kealaolu and Kahala Avenues, Diamond Head Rd again, and the finish on Kalakaua Ave at Kapiolani Park, matching the organiser's 2026 course map. Route traced over OpenStreetMap streets; the course's certificate isn't public, so distance is calibrated to the finish. Elevations from USGS 3DEP lidar (NOAA Maui and Oahu, 2020); canal and stream bridges are interpolated. Unofficial.
